facts.fact: KRAY 在国会东南宾夕法尼亚大道旁的星巴克与 HPSCI 幕僚 D. B. Cooper 并排坐下，开口问对方手里有什么。
facts.anchor: “Okay, so what have you got?” said KRAY, sitting next to D. B. Cooper, the HPSCI Staffer, at the Starbucks just down Pennsylvania Avenue, Southeast, from the U.S. Capitol.

facts.fact: 时间是晚上八点半；KRAY 按事先约定用投币电话联系 Cooper，报出的化名是「Marcel Duchamp」。
facts.anchor: It was 8:30 in the evening. KRAY had called from a pay phone, identifying himself as “Marcel Duchamp” like he said he would.

facts.fact: Cooper 拿出一份名单，上面是十三个外国城市里的十三个化名（pseudos）。
facts.anchor: “I’ve got a list,” said Cooper. “Thirteen pseudos in thirteen foreign cities.”

facts.fact: 后座男子伸手自报家门 Wayne Skinner，让 KRAY 直接叫他 Wayne，并反问对方是不是 Marcel。
facts.anchor: “Wayne Skinner,” said the man, sticking out his hand. “Call me Wayne. Yer name be Marcel?”

facts.fact: Skinner 转述 Wacker 拒绝儿媳 Tabitha 的 CIA 申请时说的话：这大概不合规矩，而且远超职业规范。
facts.anchor: He says, ‘This is probably improper and way beyond the perfessional.’

facts.fact: Skinner 说 Wacker 的上级告诉总统，不审查那名后来死于爆炸的 ex-SEAL 是 Wacker 的主意，而死者是总统的朋友。
facts.anchor: Wacker’s bosses told the President it was his idea not to check the guy out. That ex-SEAL that died, he was a friend a the President’s.

facts.fact: Cooper 答应第二天下午下班前把索取报告的要求送到 Wacker 手上。
facts.anchor: “It’ll be in his hands by COB tomorrow,” said Cooper.

facts.fact: Cooper 把黑色背包交给 KRAY，说明里面是二十万美元，全是二十元面钞。
facts.anchor: “That bag has two hundred grand in it,” D. B. Cooper told KRAY. “In twenties.”
